claims.name: AuthenticationController
responsibilities: maps request parameters role, name, surname, email, password, identifier and returns a UserDTO

claims.name: LibraryFacade
responsibilities: single entry point that forwards register to UserManager

claims.name: UserManager
responsibilities: creates the user through a factory and registers it

claims.name: UserRegistry
responsibilities: looks up users, students and librarians by email, student number or code

claims.name: PersistenceManager
responsibilities: persists entities in a JPA transaction, returns false and rolls back on failure

claims.name: RestExceptionHandler
responsibilities: maps IllegalArgumentException and IllegalStateException to HTTP 400 with an error message

claims.name: StudentFactory
responsibilities: creates a Student with the student number set from the identifier

claims.name: LibrarianFactory
responsibilities: creates a Librarian with the internal identifier code set from the identifier
